title: 序列顺序查询排名
summary: 动态加入景点名称与分数；第 k 次 get 返回当前排名第 k 好的景点，排名按分数降序、同分名称升序。
insight: 维护两个堆：selected 包含已执行 get 次数个最优景点，堆顶是其中最差者；remaining 堆顶是未选景点中最好者。add 后交换越界元素，get 把 remaining 最好者移入 selected 并返回。
pitfalls: 每次 get 的 k 自动递增
add 可发生在 get 之间

solutions.title: 已选与未选双排名堆
solutions.idea: 用两个相反比较器维护动态前 k 分界。
steps: remaining 按最好优先：score 降、name 升；selected 按最差优先：score 升、name 降
add 放 remaining；若 remaining 最好优于 selected 最差则交换
get：弹 remaining 最好加入 selected 并返回名称

code.java: class SORTracker { static class Place{String name;int score;Place(String name,int score){this.name=name;this.score=score;}}Comparator<Place> better=(a,b)->a.score!=b.score?b.score-a.score:a.name.compareTo(b.name);Comparator<Place> worse=(a,b)->a.score!=b.score?a.score-b.score:b.name.compareTo(a.name);PriorityQueue<Place> selected=new PriorityQueue<>(worse),remaining=new PriorityQueue<>(better);public SORTracker(){}public void add(String name,int score){remaining.offer(new Place(name,score));if(!selected.isEmpty()&&better.compare(remaining.peek(),selected.peek())<0){Place best=remaining.poll(),worst=selected.poll();remaining.offer(worst);selected.offer(best);}}public String get(){Place next=remaining.poll();selected.offer(next);return next.name;} }
code.kotlin: class SORTracker { data class Place(val name:String,val score:Int);private val better=compareByDescending<Place>{it.score}.thenBy{it.name};private val worse=compareBy<Place>{it.score}.thenByDescending{it.name};private val selected=java.util.PriorityQueue<Place>(worse);private val remaining=java.util.PriorityQueue<Place>(better);fun add(name:String,score:Int){remaining.add(Place(name,score));if(selected.isNotEmpty()&&better.compare(remaining.peek(),selected.peek())<0){val best=remaining.remove();val worst=selected.remove();remaining.add(worst);selected.add(best)}}fun get():String{val next=remaining.remove();selected.add(next);return next.name}}
code.cpp: class SORTracker { struct Place{string name;int score;};struct Better{bool operator()(const Place& a,const Place& b)const{return a.score!=b.score?a.score<b.score:a.name>b.name;}};struct Worse{bool operator()(const Place& a,const Place& b)const{return a.score!=b.score?a.score>b.score:a.name<b.name;}};priority_queue<Place,vector<Place>,Worse> selected;priority_queue<Place,vector<Place>,Better> remaining;bool isBetter(const Place& a,const Place& b){return a.score!=b.score?a.score>b.score:a.name<b.name;}public: SORTracker(){}void add(string name,int score){remaining.push({name,score});if(!selected.empty()&&isBetter(remaining.top(),selected.top())){Place best=remaining.top(),worst=selected.top();remaining.pop();selected.pop();remaining.push(worst);selected.push(best);}}string get(){Place next=remaining.top();remaining.pop();selected.push(next);return next.name;} };
